text:
Type: round beveled wall mirror
Use: reflecting light, decorating a wall above a console or sofa; living room, hallway, bedroom, bathroom
Style: modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: mirror glass with a beveled edge, thin metal backing rim
Colors: silver mirror, grey metal
Shape: flat circle with a faceted bevel around the rim, slim metal edge visible from the side, frameless look, light and bright
Feel: bright, clean, elegant, open
Goes with: any wall color, brass or black accents, consoles, wood or marble; modern, contemporary or art deco rooms

product.name: RONGLAN
product.description: Provided with safety film - reduces damage if glass is broken.
